subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should trusted HTTP callers be allowed to trigger the existing Gateway `update.run` self-update flow, and if yes should that be exposed by expanding the default-off admin HTTP RPC allowlist rather than adding `POST /admin/update`?
rationale: This decides whether host package-manager work and restart orchestration may cross an HTTP operator boundary; the current code has the update primitive but intentionally does not expose it through the HTTP admin plugin.

options.title: Expose through admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Approve a narrow `update.run` allowlist expansion in the existing default-off plugin, with docs and security tests for trusted private ingress only.

options.title: Keep HTTP update blocked
options.body: Leave update execution on CLI/WebSocket control-plane surfaces and keep HTTP admin RPC limited to status/observability methods.

options.title: Design a separate endpoint
options.body: Sponsor a new HTTP endpoint only if maintainers want a response contract materially different from Gateway RPC.

recommendation.title: Expose through admin HTTP RPC
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow `update.run` allowlist expansion in the existing default-off plugin, with docs and security tests for trusted private ingress only.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and hardened the update.run control-plane flow and authored the admin HTTP RPC implementation commits, so he is the best available owner for this security-boundary choice.
